protocol_amendment.reason: The verified version-1 development preflight exposed a mismatch between the optimizer tie order and its support-at-density claim, plus ambiguous energy, incomplete duplicate-draw provenance, and nonreplayable capped frontier summaries.
changes: Replace the single unconstrained lexicographic ratio with support optimization at absolute constrained-label caps floor(q/4), floor(q/2), floor(3q/4), and q.
At each cap, minimize attained constrained labels and public edges before maximizing retained maxima after the primary support objective.
Serialize the complete live search frontier for every capped result and require independent bound replay.
Separate formal-multiset collision energy from multinomially weighted ordered-tuple additive energy.
Rename raw final support as balanced_raw_final_support and report full eight_fold_support separately.
Record duplicate curve candidates as rejected draws.
Authorize unit and frozen-fixture controls only; no additional development family rows.
